issues.issue: Irrigation district O&M assessments are levied per acre on district lands. 'special assessments' is a defensible alternative (already marked review).
Irrigation/water districts are listed under 'natural resources/conservation' in the disbursement rules. 'utilities' is a judgment call.
This is an irrigation district, not a public power district. Treating it as entirely business-type is defensible ('many water districts'), but the entity_type label is misleading.
